property_summary: For all inputs where a caller with >= MinSum calls Collect(amount) after funding and after unlockTime, the reference contract always decreases that caller's Acc(msg.sender).balance by exactly amount after Collect returns; the mutant that removed the nonReentrant_ guard can be re-entered by a malicious recipient during the external call so the balance after Collect may be larger (i.e. not decreased by the full amount) for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Change the nonReentrant_ modifier to remove the reentrancy guard by returning early (no locking) so Collect can be reentered; replace require(!locked_) with no check.
